entities.summary: Sinuiju Special Administrative Region (Korean: 신의주특별행정구) was a planned special administrative region (SAR) of North Korea based in the city of Sinuiju. Proclaimed in 2002, the SAR was envisioned to be directly governed, having been split off from North Pyongan Province, as is the case for "Directly Governed Cities" but has yet to be put into de facto operation.
